## Change

Describe the behavior or contract changed, what now ships, the regression-coverage outcome, and the affected workspace(s).

## Not included

List material deferred behavior this pull request leaves unchanged, or remove this section when nothing is deferred.

## Verification

List exact commands, workspace, and results. Use `cargo nextest` for tests. Note visual states, dimensions, and evidence when UI behavior changes.

## Migration notes

Describe required caller or data migration steps, or write “None.”

## Readiness and compatibility

State any remaining parity, API, safety, platform, or proof-tooling limitation. Do not describe a branch as ready based only on compilation or a partial test/capture pass.
